page.overview:
Who is Yuji Ide?

= Yuji Ide = Yuji Ide (井出 有治, Ide Yūji; born 21 January 1975) is a Japanese professional racing driver who drove in F1 for the Super Aguri team during the 2006 season. Prior to Formula One, Ide had a long career in Japanese single-seater racing, particularly in Formula Nippon (now Super Formula), and later competed in endurance racing, including the Super GT series.{{Infobox Driver

Ide began karting in the late 1980s before progressing into Japanese Formula 3, where he raced between 1997 and 1999. He achieved modest results, with occasional podium finishes, but did not secure a championship challenge. He later moved into Formula Nippon, Japan’s premier single-seater championship, establishing himself as a consistent midfield competitor.

Between 2003 and 2005, Ide scored several podiums in Formula Nippon and developed a reputation as a solid but not front-running driver. His domestic career opened the door to an opportunity in Formula One when the newly formed Super Aguri F1 team sought Japanese talent.

In early 2006, Ide was announced as a race driver for the newly established Super Aguri F1 Team, which entered Formula One as a Honda-backed operation. Ide partnered with compatriot Takuma Sato.
